name: Cyprodime
summary: Cyprodime is an opioid antagonist from the morphinan family of drugs.

pharmacology.text: Cyprodime is an opioid antagonist from the morphinan family of drugs. Cyprodime is a selective opioid antagonist which blocks the μ-opioid receptor, but without affecting the δ-opioid or κ-opioid receptors.

uses.en: It is a laboratory research tool used to study mu opioid receptors. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究 μ 鴉片類受體的實驗室工具，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究 μ 鸦片类受体的实验室工具，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: Unlike naloxone, which blocks all three main opioid receptors, cyprodime blocks only the mu receptor. This makes it useful for working out which receptor causes a particular effect.
fact.zh: 納洛酮會阻斷三種主要的鴉片類受體，但 cyprodime 只阻斷 μ 受體。這讓它很適合用來釐清某種作用是由哪一種受體造成的。
fact.zhHans: 纳洛酮会阻断三种主要的鸦片类受体，但 cyprodime 只阻断 μ 受体。这让它很适合用来厘清某种作用是由哪一种受体造成的。
